about:
Click Therapeutics is headquartered in New York, New York. Founded in 2012 by David Benshoof Klein, who recognized the impact of smartphones on behavior and cognition and began developing mobile-application-based treatments, coining the term "Digital Therapeutics™." The company is backed by biotech and pharma investors including HIG, Accelmed, and Sanofi Ventures.

The company develops, validates, and commercializes software as prescription medical treatments. Its multimodal platform, Click SE™, combines software with pharmacotherapy to create software-enhanced drug treatments. The pipeline includes FDA-cleared products such as CT-152 (Rejoyn) for major depressive disorder, CT-155 (Motivista) for negative symptoms of schizophrenia, AspyreRx for type 2 diabetes, and CT-132 for episodic migraine, along with earlier-stage programs for opioid use disorder, multiple sclerosis, atopic dermatitis, obesity, oncology, insomnia, and acute coronary syndrome. The team spans clinicians, researchers, and technologists who conduct clinical trials and manage regulatory submissions.

Click Therapeutics serves the life sciences, digital health, and medical device industries, working with pharmaceutical partners such as Otsuka to co-develop prescription digital therapeutics. Its treatments are prescribed by physicians and reimbursed as drug-software combination products, targeting patients with unmet needs in psychiatry, neurology, metabolic disease, and oncology.

The company was started to leverage software to improve clinical outcomes and bridge gaps in treatment access, aiming to provide patients everywhere access to safe and effective prescription digital therapeutics. Its differentiators include an AI-enabled platform, a first FDA-cleared prescription app for adjunctive MDD treatment developed with Otsuka, and a pipeline spanning multiple therapeutic areas.
